note: PLUGIN-010 recover plugin crash: src/plugin/recovery.zig sets the status to unknown when a plugin terminates, because the work may have completed before the process died or may never have started, and both failed and succeeded would be guesses. Reconciliation against evidence settles it: a verified artifact means succeeded, a log showing the action ran without its artifact means failed, and a log claiming completion without the artifact is a contradiction that resolves against the log because the artifact is what downstream actions consume. With no artifact and no log the status stays unknown and nothing is cached - and the cache refuses unknown and running outright, so it cannot be used to carry an unreconciled answer into a later run. Writing the module exposed an ambiguity in my own first model: absent-artifact alone cannot distinguish never-started from ran-and-failed, so the log state is explicit instead of inferred from a boolean. Fault proof: reading absent evidence as success makes the no-false-success assertions fail (exit 1); revert byte-identical against a backup, no FAULT markers remain.
authority: self-reported local review, not independent attestation
